title: OpenBao SLO and availability
description: OpenBao SLO and availability. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. See the profile validation record for tested environments and native alert coverage.

options.query:
| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_core_active")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_core_active"
| eval series=cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("probe_success")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="probe_success"
| search job=$probe_job|s$
| stats avg(value) AS value min(_time) AS oldest max(_time) AS newest count AS observations BY _timeseries cluster
| addinfo
| eval complete=if(observations>=171072 AND oldest<=info_max_time-2591970 AND newest>=info_max_time-45,1,0)
| eventstats min(complete) AS complete_cluster BY cluster
| where complete_cluster=1
| stats avg(value) AS value BY cluster
| fields value

| `openbao_metric_samples("probe_success")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="probe_success"
| search job=$probe_job|s$
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats time_window=1h avg(value) AS value BY _timeseries
| eval _time=bucket_time, series=instance ." | ".job ." | ".cluster
| timechart span=15s avg(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("probe_success")`

viz_active_node_context.title: Active node context
viz_active_node_context.description: Sum of observed active flags across source targets per bucket. Missing targets are unknown; an observed zero remains zero.

viz_availability_30d.title: Availability 30d
viz_availability_30d.description: Requires stable probe targets with 30 days of history, at least 99% of expected 15-second samples per target, a first sample within 30 seconds of the window boundary, and a last sample within 45 seconds. Incomplete or stale history returns no value. Targets are weighted equally after averaging their observed samples. Fixed window to now, independent of the picker.

viz_availability_by_target.title: Availability by target
viz_availability_by_target.description: Requires externally collected probe_success and probe_duration_seconds with bounded job, instance, and cluster labels. Availability averages observed samples per target, then targets; absent probes are not successes. A 30-day result requires 30 days of source retention and collection. Fixed-window stats always use the trailing window to now, independent of the picker. Error budgets use a validated objective between zero and one.

viz_login_latency.title: Login latency
viz_login_latency.description: Rolling 5m calculation from upstream counters; resets are corrected per complete source series before aggregation. Means are weighted by observations; idle windows remain absent. Namespace and deployment identity are retained. Chart series are limited to 20; select one cluster and scrape profile for single-value panels.

viz_operational_availability_context.title: Operational availability context
viz_operational_availability_context.description: OpenBao JSON operational logs. Only timestamp, host, severity, module, and message are exposed. Error text can contain sensitive information. Charts use disjoint five-minute buckets; this is not a client-latency measurement.
